title: Inner Circle Honoured
body: On this day in 2019, brothers Ian and Roger Lewis of Inner Circle, the 'Bad Boys of Reggae', received Jamaica's Order of Distinction at King's House for decades of spreading reggae worldwide.

title: Happy Birthday, Shaggy
body: Born on this day in 1968 in Kingston, Orville 'Shaggy' Burrell took Jamaican music to the top of the world charts with 'Boombastic' and 'It Wasn't Me'. Which Shaggy tune gets you moving?

title: Friday Question
body: What reggae song never fails to lift your spirit? Drop it in the comments!

title: Happy Birthday, Pablove Black
body: Born on this day in 1950, keyboardist Pablove Black joined the Studio One crew in 1971 and later worked at Lee 'Scratch' Perry's Black Ark. Big up the session greats!

title: Remembering the Cool Ruler
body: On this day in 2010, we lost Gregory Isaacs, the Cool Ruler. His smooth, aching voice made him one of lovers rock's greatest singers. Which Gregory tune is your all-time favourite?

title: Happy Birthday, Eek-A-Mouse
body: Born on this day in 1957, Eek-A-Mouse brought one of the most unique voices in reggae, with his famous 'biddy-bye' scat style. Big up the Mouse!

title: Two Legends, One Birthday
body: November 22 belongs to two giants: Max Romeo, born in 1944, voice of 'War Ina Babylon', and Aston 'Family Man' Barrett, born in 1946, the bass heartbeat of Bob Marley & The Wailers.

title: Happy Birthday, Marcia Griffiths
body: Born on this day in 1949, Marcia Griffiths, the Queen of Reggae, sang with Bob Marley as one of the I-Threes and gave the world 'Electric Boogie'.

title: Reggae: Heritage of Humanity
body: On this day in 2018, UNESCO added reggae music of Jamaica to its list of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity. From Kingston yards to the whole world!

title: 56 Hope Road, 1976
body: On this day in 1976, gunmen attacked Bob Marley's home at 56 Hope Road in Kingston. Bob, Rita and manager Don Taylor were wounded, but all survived.

title: Smile Jamaica
body: Just two days after being shot, Bob Marley took the stage at the Smile Jamaica concert in National Heroes Park on this day in 1976. A true act of courage.

title: Toots, and Remembering Robbie
body: Born on this day in 1942, Toots Hibbert gave reggae its name with 'Do the Reggay'. Today we also remember Robbie Shakespeare of Sly & Robbie, who passed on December 8, 2021.

title: Remembering Garnett Silk
body: On this day in 1994, Garnett Silk died at just 28, trying to save his mother from a house fire. His voice and conscious message live on.

title: Happy Birthday, Carly Barrett
body: Born on this day in 1950, Carlton 'Carly' Barrett was the drummer of Bob Marley & The Wailers and a master of the one-drop rhythm.

title: Happy Birthday, Mutabaruka
body: Born on this day in 1952, Mutabaruka, dub poet, philosopher and broadcaster, has spent decades sharpening minds with words over riddims.
